submitted.rationale: Highest measured photocurrent: 2.09e-6 A at Mn0.86Sr0.14. Mn0.80 gave almost the same value (2.08e-6 A), and Mn0.50 was much lower (7e-7 A). XRD at Mn 0.86, 0.80 and 0.72 shows one phase whose peaks shift slightly with composition, so there is no phase change in the Mn-rich region that would point to a different optimum. The Mn-rich end looks best, and it is flat between Mn 0.80 and 0.86.

rejected.reason: Photocurrent 7e-7 A, about 3x lower than the Mn-rich end
2.08e-6 A, essentially tied with index 0 but marginally lower
Photocurrent falls as Sr increases (Mn0.86 to Mn0.50), so Sr-rich films are unlikely to do better. They were not measured.
